# forge-example-usd-savings-vault

> Composed ERC-4626 savings vault that reports value in USD via a Chainlink feed, with a USD deposit cap, entry fee (max 5%) and RISK_MANAGER_ROLE controls (UsdSavingsVault), plus a viem front end on GitHub Pages.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/forge-example-usd-savings-vault/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/forge-example-usd-savings-vault/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/forge-example-usd-savings-vault/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [src/UsdSavingsVault.sol](https://github.com/Blockchains/forge-example-usd-savings-vault/blob/main/src/UsdSavingsVault.sol): contract
- [component-map.json](https://github.com/Blockchains/forge-example-usd-savings-vault/blob/main/component-map.json): provenance
- [NOTICE](https://github.com/Blockchains/forge-example-usd-savings-vault/blob/main/NOTICE): attribution
